meta.title: 拍照超显脸小pose📸这几个动作超显瘦
meta.title_en: Poses That Make Your Face Look Smaller in Photos

scenes.title_en: Angle Toward the Lens: 15-Degree Tilt and a Jawline Sweep
scenes.context: 显脸小不是撑脸拍，而是斜15度追镜头、一手扫出下颌线、另一手向斜前45度延伸。语域：姿势教学，纠错示范。
sentences: 想显脸小，不是这样撑脸拍。
To look slimmer, don't prop your face on your hand like this.
prop your face（撑脸）；look slimmer（显脸小）
而是斜15度追镜头。
Instead, tilt 15 degrees toward the lens.
tilt toward the lens（斜向镜头）
一只手轻轻扫出下颌线。
Sweep your jawline with one hand, gently.
sweep your jawline（扫下颌线）
另一只手向斜前45度延伸。
Extend the other hand forward at a 45-degree angle.
extend forward（向前延伸）
paraphrase: 撑脸 → prop your face / rest your face on your hand
prop face · rest face
显脸小 → look slimmer / make your face look smaller
look slimmer · face smaller
扫下颌线 → sweep the jawline / trace the jaw
sweep jawline · trace jaw
scenes.speak: To look slimmer, don't prop your face on your hand like this. Instead, tilt 15 degrees toward the lens. Sweep your jawline with one hand, gently, and extend the other hand forward at a 45-degree angle.

scenes.title_cn: 杯子挡脸：一手平放一手前伸
scenes.title_en: Covering With a Cup: One Hand Flat, One Reaching Forward
scenes.context: 杯子挡脸不是拿杯贴脸拍，而是先一手平放桌面，另一手拿杯子往前伸。语域：姿势教学，纠错示范。
sentences: 杯子挡脸不是这样拍。
That's not how you pose with a cup in front of your face.
a cup in front of your face（杯子挡脸）
一个手平放桌面。
Rest one hand flat on the table.
rest flat on the table（平放桌面）
另一只手拿杯子往前伸。
Reach the other hand forward holding the cup.
reach forward（往前伸）
paraphrase: 平放 → rest flat / lay it flat
rest flat · lay flat
前伸 → reach forward / extend out
reach forward · extend out
scenes.speak: That's not how you pose with a cup in front of your face. Rest one hand flat on the table, and reach the other hand forward holding the cup.

scenes.title_cn: 手撑脸：反手注视下颌角
scenes.title_en: Hand-to-Face: Rest on the Back of Your Hand and Look Down
scenes.context: 手撑脸不是直接撑，而是反手注视下颌角，另一只手平放桌面。语域：姿势教学，纠错示范。
sentences: 再手撑脸，不是这样拍。
And for a hand-to-face pose, not like that either.
hand-to-face pose（手撑脸姿势）
而是反手注视下颌角。
Instead, rest on the back of your hand and look down at your jaw.
back of your hand（反手）；look down（注视下方）
另一只手平放在桌面上。
Keep the other hand flat on the table.
keep flat（保持平放）
paraphrase: 反手 → the back of your hand / hand turned backward
back of hand · turned backward
注视下颌 → look toward your jaw / gaze downward
look toward jaw · gaze downward
scenes.speak: And for a hand-to-face pose, not like that either. Instead, rest on the back of your hand and look down at your jaw. Keep the other hand flat on the table.

scenes.title_cn: 进阶收尾：杯子侧放与撩发
scenes.title_en: Advanced Finish: Cup to the Side and a Hair Flip
scenes.context: 拿杯不贴脸，杯子拿向身侧、头往后放、单手后撩；最后特写手前伸加撩头发收尾。语域：姿势教学，进阶引导。
sentences: 拿杯子，不是这样。
Don't hold the cup like that.
hold the cup（拿杯子）
而是杯子拿向身侧。
Move the cup to the side of your body instead.
to the side of your body（向身侧）
头往后放，单手后撩。
Let your head fall back and toss your hair back with one hand.
toss your hair back（向后撩发）
特写手前伸，单手撩头发。
Close-up: reach one hand forward and flip your hair with the other.
close-up（特写）；flip your hair（撩头发）
paraphrase: 向身侧 → to the side of your body / off to the side
to the side · off to side
撩发 → toss your hair back / flip your hair
toss hair · flip hair
特写 → close-up / a tight shot
close-up · tight shot
scenes.speak: Don't hold the cup like that. Move the cup to the side of your body instead, let your head fall back and toss your hair back with one hand. Close-up: reach one hand forward and flip your hair with the other.

practice: Tilt 15 degrees toward the lens and sweep your jawline with one hand.
说杯子挡脸的正确拍法
Rest one hand flat on the table and reach the other forward holding the cup.
Rest on the back of your hand and look down at your jaw.
Move the cup to the side, and flip your hair with one hand.
pitfalls: I prop my face on my hand to look slimmer.
Prop your face and it looks wider — tilt 15 degrees toward the lens instead.
撑脸反而显脸大，正确做法是斜向镜头加手部层次。
I hold the cup against my face.
Don't hold the cup against your face — rest one hand flat and reach forward with the other.
杯子挡脸是「前伸制造景深」，不是贴脸遮挡。
I rest my chin directly on my palm.
Rest on the back of your hand and look down at your jaw.
手撑脸用反手姿势，视线向下更显脸小。
I reach my hand straight at the camera.
Reach forward at an angle for depth — a straight reach looks flat.
手前伸要有角度和特写，直直伸手缺乏层次。
shifts: 只会说 make my face small
用 tilt toward the lens（斜向镜头）、sweep the jawline（扫下颌线）、foreground depth（前景层次）
用 rest one hand flat（一手平放）、reach forward（前伸）、to the side of your body（向身侧）细分动作
用 toss your hair back（向后撩）、flip your hair（撩头发）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：下跃线→下颌线、下跃角→下颌角、后梢→后撩、特身手前伸→特写手前伸。
